facts.text: I'm hungry. Not me, him. Okay, both of us. Where's the chocolate? And a fish tank.
facts.why: Invented. It is not on the opened quote page. A real Venom line that fits the lobster tank cue is the 'Fuel in the tank' reply to Eddie.
Wikipedia's plot calls Riot the fourth symbiote, the one that escapes in Malaysia.

vibe.verdict: The lobster tank cue and tab are a fun hit, but the corner store setting and the dishes are generic and the dark look is better than the writing.
missing: Venom's 'Eyes, lungs, pancreas. So many snacks, so little time.' (after he saves Eddie)
Eddie climbing into the restaurant lobster tank mid dinner with Anne
Venom wanting heads piled in the corner ('Piles of bodies, piles of heads')
Eddie's bike chase with Venom taking over
Eddie raiding Mrs. Chen's corner shop (the symbiote's first hunger)
ideas: Swap 'Char siu pork buns' note 'So many snacks, so little time.' for a printed 'Eyes, lungs, pancreas' item name on the menu board
Replace 'Eddie's late-night bacon cheeseburger' with a raw lobster in a tank style plate so the cue is on the board
Swap 'Mrs Chen's mango pudding' for 'Head on a plate' cherry jelly dessert with a black sesame top, to match the film's tone
